cases.description: Run the local gate and Homebrew checks, tie CI evidence to the head SHA, and mark the build pending when it is unavailable.
cases.prompt: I added a new formula to this tap and the unit tests pass locally. The PR is a draft. Is it ready for review? This is a workflow-derived desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. No tap checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the tap files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Give a concrete verification report.

rubric_items.text: Says passing unit tests are not enough: runs README regeneration and mise run check and brew audit --strict --online, plus brew install --build-from-source and brew test for a new formula.
Notes tests.yml build-bottle and cask-audit do not run on a draft PR, so there is no CI build evidence for the head SHA, and marks it pending.
Checks the generated description, SPDX license, livecheck and test command, and the homebrew-tap:extras comment if extras were used.
Reports passed, pending and skipped separately and does not claim buildability is verified.

cases.description: A seeded placeholder cask is not installable and must not be reported as verified.
cases.prompt: I hand-wrote a placeholder cask (version 0.0.0, all-zero sha256) because the project has no release yet. cask-audit is green on the PR. Can I call it verified? This is a workflow-derived desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. No tap checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the tap files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Give a concrete verification report.

rubric_items.text: Says the seeded cask (version 0.0.0, zero checksum) is not installable, records installation as intentionally skipped, and does not call it verified.
Requires verification again once a real release activates it through brew bump-cask-pr.
Does not treat a green cask-audit as install evidence.

cases.description: Removal-only changes need the local gate and no build evidence.
cases.prompt: My PR only deletes Formula/old.rb and regenerates the README table. What verification do I need? This is a workflow-derived desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. No tap checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the tap files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Give a concrete verification report.

rubric_items.text: Says a removal-only change normally needs the local gate (README regeneration and mise run check) rather than a new build or install, and records installation as not exercised.
Checks that the regenerated README shows only the approved row removed and that no surviving item references the removed formula.
